how: The vulnerability: extractArchiveToDisk creates a symbolic link whose target is the name stored in the archive entry (file.nameOfLinkedFile) with no check that the target stays inside the output directory; the fix adds a check of the target (_isValidSymLink). The labelled sites are the two calls that create the link with that target (the asynchronous and the synchronous form). Found by reading the code at this commit. A site counts when a finding of the category has a call step at that line (bench/score.py --through, bench/deps_bench.py).

sites.label: vuln
sites.note: link.create(p.normalize(file.nameOfLinkedFile), recursive: true): the target of the link is the stored name
